mentions.name: AssetJay
mentions.description: AssetJay is an asset management tool for companies without IT departments, making it easy to keep track of all the devices and peripherals a company owns.
mentions.problem: Companies without IT departments struggle to keep track of all the devices and peripherals they own.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently building AssetJay, an asset management tools for companies without IT departments.
